name: Tanvi Foods (India) Limited
about: Tanvi Foods (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, processing, marketing, and sale of frozen food products, frozen vegetables, frozen snacks, ready-to-eat food, and other processed agricultural products in India. The company offers fresh and frozen agricultural products comprising sweet corn, green peas, mixed vegetables, jackfruits, ivy gourds, carrots, drumsticks, okras, beetroots, and green chillis; frozen dals and curries, including ridge gourd, bottle gourd, and brinjal masala curries, as well as tomato and mango dals, lady's finger gravies, sambar, rasam, and pachi pulusu; frozen vegetable chutneys, such as brinjal and cucumber, cabbage and tomato, coconut and red chilli, coriander, gongura, mango and coconut, peanut, red gram, ridge gourd and ivy gourd, ridge gourd and tomato, tomato, and tomato and bottle gourd; and corn patties. It also provides frozen snack products, such as corn, onion, paneer, Irani, and vegetable samosas; corn, paneer, Shanghai, and chocolate rolls; and veg bites, veg fingers, veg lollipops, and hara bara kebabs. In addition, the company offers cold-storage, warehousing, and refrigerated-storage services. Further, it trades in frozen food, including fresh and frozen corn products. The company exports its products. The company sells its products under the Frozen King's and Corn Club brands. Tanvi Foods (India) Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Krishna, India.
